name: MonarchToggleButtonStyle
title: ToggleButton
summary: A button look for the standard Toggle that stays on or off, such as Bold in a text toolbar or "Show archived" above a list.
whenToUse: For an option that is switched in place and shown as a button, alone or in a row of formatting controls.
whenNotToUse: For a setting in a list, use a plain Toggle (a switch). For selecting items or agreeing to terms, use the checkbox style. For one choice from a set, use a segmented Picker.
api: static func monarchButton(_ variant: MonarchToggleButtonVariant = .ghost, size: MonarchButtonSize = .md, tone: MonarchTone = .accent) -> MonarchToggleButtonStyle
MonarchToggleButtonStyle.init(_ variant: MonarchToggleButtonVariant = .ghost, size: MonarchButtonSize = .md, tone: MonarchTone = .accent)

options.name: variant
options.description: ghost has no fill or border while off; outline is a bordered surface while off.

options.name: size
options.description: sm (32), md (36) or lg (40) points high.

options.name: tone
options.description: The colours while on: the accent, or .ai for an AI control.

states.name: off
states.description: Muted text. Ghost has no fill or border; outline has the surface fill and the default border.

states.name: on
states.description: The accent subtle fill, an accent border and accent text, in both variants. With Differentiate Without Colour a checkmark is added before the label.

states.name: pressed
states.description: A darker fill; not animated when Reduce Motion is on.

states.name: disabled
states.description: The disabled text colour. An on button keeps a muted fill and a subtle border, so on and off still differ.

appearance: Off uses the muted text colour and, for outline, the surface and default border. On uses the accent subtle fill, the accent border and the accent strong text, in every theme; the high-contrast themes resolve the same roles to stronger colours.
platformNotes: The web ToggleButton is a button with aria-pressed and the variants default and outline; here it is a ToggleStyle, so the control stays a standard Toggle, and the variants are named ghost and outline after the button variants they map to on the web. The web has controlled and uncontrolled forms; a Toggle always has a binding. Android themes the Material toggle button. The system button toggle style (.button) is the unstyled alternative.
accessibility: VoiceOver is given a standard Toggle with the same label and binding, so the role, the on and off values and the activation gesture are the system's.
The touch target is at least 44 by 44 points at every size.
The label scales with Dynamic Type and wraps instead of truncating.
On is shown by a fill and a border, and with the Differentiate Without Colour setting also by a checkmark.
The label must name the thing that is switched and must not change with the state.
The transitions are not animated when Reduce Motion is on.
edgeCases: The mixed state of Toggle(sources:isOn:) has no look of its own: the button shows on only when the toggle reports on.
With labelStyle(.iconOnly) the title is hidden but stays the spoken name.
A long label wraps and the button grows.
